finalText:
Build's clean now — 0 errors, exit 0.

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js:17`: `maxRetries: retries` referenced a variable that never existed, so every build crashed with `ReferenceError: retries is not defined` at the link stage. Fixed it to read `env.retries`, falling back to `3`.

The three warnings are unrelated and harmless — a deprecated `crypto.createCipher` call, an unused export, and a circular import — worth cleaning up eventually but not build-breaking.
